name: Meditation
description: A calm timer with a sunset glow, rain, ocean, fire or wind sounds made on the fly, singing bowl bells and a daily streak.
prompt: A meditation timer from 3 to 20 minutes with a glowing sun, a progress ring, ambient sounds generated in the browser (rain, ocean, fire, wind), bells at the start, end and optional intervals, gentle quotes, and stats for streak and total minutes.
author: gonzaroman
